name: Sakurai Futamigaura
description: A celebrated west-coast viewpoint in Itoshima where a white torii gate stands before the Meoto Iwa (married-couple rocks) in the sea, popular for sunsets and photography.
highlights: The white torii gate and Meoto Iwa offshore
